newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - SGST cuts Pilkington.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - SGST cuts Pilkington.

text.p: Estimates for pre-tax profit at glassmaker Pilkington Plc were cut at SG Strauss Turnbull, analyst Howard Proctor at the brokerage said on Thursday.

Proctor said the downgrade reflected continued pressure on prices in continental Europe and said he expected the stock to trade in a range between 180p and 210p until the situation eased, though it was cheap on its fundamentals.
For 1996 Proctor cut his pre-tax profit estimate to 190 million stg from 219 million and for the following year he cut to 240 million stg from 276 million.
The stock was up 2-1/2p at 189-1/2 by 1407 GMT.
